module: Tiny GE extension (core_activity): starts a named 'activity'. Today the only known activity is 'ContinueFreeroam', which launches extensions.freeroam_continueFreeroam.start() then signals the loading screen (core_gamestate.loadingScreenActive()). A modder can call it from the UI or a script.
notes: An unknown activity name is only logged (level I): no error is raised.
The code comment says the call to core_gamestate.loadingScreenActive() is to be removed once the UI is added.

startActivity.desc: Launches the activity with this name if it exists in the internal table, otherwise logs 'Unknown activity'.
